It looks to me that 1.5.1 and 1.8.1 overlap in terms in "policy compliance" a little. Looks odd to me.

1.5.1 | Verify that input and output requirements clearly define how to handle and process data based on type, content, and applicable laws, regulations, and other policy compliance. |   | ✓ | ✓ | 1029
-- | -- | -- | -- | -- | --

1.8.1 | [MODIFIED, MERGED FROM 8.3.4, LEVEL L2 > L1] Verify that all sensitive data created and processed by the application has been identified and classified into protection levels, and ensure that a policy is in place on how to deal with sensitive data. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | 213

previous_versions.body:
I re-open the issue to handle overlapping parts separately.

I propose we leave 1.8.1 as it is and remove the policy and sensitive information part from 1.5.1 (as it should only address that the content is in the expected format).

Both requirements may need some additional modifications, but let's handle those case by case.

Level change:
As this is the pre-condition requirement for 5.1.3 and 5.1.4, which are level 1 requirements, 1.5.1 must also be a level 1 requirement.

CWE change:
* from [CWE-1029](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1029.html) OWASP Top Ten 2017 Category A3 - Sensitive Data Exposure
  * it is wrong by content and it is a category that should not be used for mapping or linking
* to [CWE-20](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/20.html) Improper Input Validation

| # | Description | L1 | L2 | L3 | CWE |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **1.5.1** | [MODIFIED, LEVEL L2 > L1] Verify that input and output requirements clearly define how to handle and process data based on type and content. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | 20 |
